content.text:
The drawing shows a benzene ring with these substituents:
- A CH(NH-tBu)CH2OH group at the left vertex (position 1).
- A CF3 group at the upper right vertex.
- NH2 at the right-lower vertex, between CF3 and Cl.
- Cl at the bottom vertex.

Numbering the ring from the side-chain carbon: C1 bears the side chain, C2 is the top vertex (H), C3 bears CF3, C4 bears NH2, C5 bears Cl, and C6 is the left-lower vertex (H). The ring is therefore 4-amino-3-chloro-5-(trifluoromethyl)phenyl.

The side chain is 2-(tert-butylamino)-2-aryl-ethanol, and the compound is drawn as the hydrochloride salt. No wedges or hashes are shown, so there is no stereochemistry.

SMILES: OCC(NC(C)(C)C)c1cc(Cl)c(N)c(c1)C(F)(F)F.Cl
